title: Meaning Contracts: Local Semantic Geometry in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.30715v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies the local geometry of semantic meaning in large language models. Current representation analyses ask whether meanings are close in embedding space, or whether linear probes separate semantic classes, but they do not characterize the within-concept local geometry: what is invariant across realizations of a single semantic factor, what varies, and what changes when meaning is refined. This paper characterizes that geometry through two controlled probes evaluated on four architecturally diverse decoder-only LLMs (Gemma 4, Llama 3.2, Qwen 2.5, Pythia). A cross-lingual probe uses language as a perturbation to separate exact meaning matches, same-factor realizations, nearby concepts, and out-of-domain contrasts. A refinement probe separates specificity-bearing semantic narrowing from high-probability attributive elaboration and adversarial controls; both probes are validated by blind human judgments. translated_title: 意义契约：大语言模型中的局部语义几何
translated_abstract: 本文研究了大语言模型中语义意义的局部几何结构。当前的表示分析关注的是意义在嵌入空间中是否相近，或者线性探针能否区分不同语义类别，但它们并未刻画概念内部的局部几何：在单一语义因子的不同实现中什么是不变的、什么是变化的，以及当意义被细化时会发生什么改变。本文通过在四个架构各异的仅解码器大语言模型（Gemma 4、Llama 3.2、Qwen 2.5、Pythia）上评估的两个受控探针来刻画这一几何结构。跨语言探针将语言作为扰动，用以区分精确意义匹配、同一语义因子的不同实现、相近概念以及域外对照；语义细化探针则将承载特定性的语义收窄与高概率的定语性修饰及对抗性对照区分开来。两个探针均通过盲测的人类判断进行了验证。四项发现在……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“意义契约”的概念，通过跨语言扰动探针和语义细化探针，在四个架构各异的大语言模型上首次系统刻画了概念内部的局部语义几何——即单一语义因子的哪些信息在不同实现中保持不变、哪些会变化，以及意义细化时如何变化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "meaning contracts" and, using cross-lingual perturbation and semantic refinement probes validated by blind human judgments, systematically characterizes the within-concept local semantic geometry of large language models—what is invariant across realizations of a single semantic factor, what varies, and how meaning changes when refined.
